messages:
maya_sales: Heads-up - were trying to lock a POC with a EU-based FinTech. They requested a temporary per-token invoice line for 90d at a lower hosted rate. Current model is redwood/open-medu-20b v1.

alex_se: Can you quantify usage profile? steady vs spikes? sync vs streaming?

maya_sales: Expect ~25-35M tokens over 90 days. Heavy spikes during integration tests (a few days where it could double). Mostly sync gen calls. Latency requirements are lenient.

alex_se: OK. Two options: (A) transient credit + standard rate (easy bookkeeping), (B) scoped per-token override on invoice for a fixed window and token cap. They prefer (B) so procurement can map to their budget line.

sam_dealdesk: We can do (B) but need guardrails: signed SOW+PO before override, an absolute dollar cap, expiry date, and finance ack. Suggest $0.012 / 1k up to 50M tokens, $800 hard cap, 90d window.

jordan_sec: Security: they require EU residency for POC traffic. No KMS/HSM needed for POC. Ill finish the SQ answers today. Call out data residency in the override note.

fin_ops: Finance note: dollar cap must be enforced at billing system level; temporary overrides still create collection risk. We need deal_id and approver in the request and a PO on file. Once docs are attached, we can sign off.

billing-bot: FYI - override API requires: {deal_id, approver, expires_at, limit_tokens, rate_per_1k, note}. See internal docs: https://redwood.internal/billing/overrides

maya_sales: I will upload the SOW + PO to the deal and ping finance. Can you provisionally open the override ticket so I can promise the customer?

sam_dealdesk: Provisional ticket opened with constraints: rate=0.012/1k, token_limit=50,000,000, dollar_cap=800, expires=90d from now. Final activation pending: (1) SOW+PO attached, (2) completed SQ, (3) finance ack.

maya_sales: Thanks. Will attach docs within the hour. Also flagging the EU residency requirement so infra can pin region.

alex_se: Once active well configure auto-revert and an alert if usage hits 70% of token or dollar cap. Also add a short-runner clause: if real usage expected to exceed cap, well pause overrides and revert to catalog pricing until new commit.

sam_dealdesk: Agreed. Adding notes to the ticket. Final approvals after docs + finance.

maya_sales: Appreciate the quick turnaround :raised_hands: were good to keep demo date if this lands today.
